_comment: Curated 'official' MCP servers fronted by the dedicated MCP APIM (infra/modules/mcpgateway.bicep), gated on an APIM subscription key. SHIPS EMPTY and the feature is default-OFF (main.bicep enableOfficialMcp=false), so the checked-in deploy provisions no MCP gateway and the app behavior is unchanged. To register a server: add an entry below, then set enableOfficialMcp=true. Example entry: { "name": "ms-learn", "displayName": "Microsoft Learn", "description": "Official Microsoft Learn MCP server", "upstreamUrl": "https://learn.microsoft.com/api/mcp", "upstreamAuthMode": "none" }
